SELECT CAST(i.id AS CHAR) AS id,
       COALESCE((
           SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT(
                      'alt_uom_id', CAST(u.alt_uom_id AS CHAR),
                      'sales_unit_price', u.sales_unit_price,
                      'sales_min_price', u.sales_min_price,
                      'sales_max_price', u.sales_max_price,
                      'min_sales_qty', u.min_sales_qty,
                      'max_sales_qty', u.max_sales_qty,
                      'mat_sales_tax_id', CAST(u.mat_sales_tax_id AS CHAR),
                      'sales_tax_percent', u.sales_tax_percent,
                      'purchase_unit_price', u.purchase_unit_price,
                      'purchase_min_price', u.purchase_min_price,
                      'purchase_max_price', u.purchase_max_price,
                      'min_purchase_qty', u.min_purchase_qty,
                      'max_purchase_qty', u.max_purchase_qty,
                      'mat_purchase_tax_id', CAST(u.mat_purchase_tax_id AS CHAR),
                      'purchase_tax_percent', u.purchase_tax_percent))
           FROM item_mji552rc_sub u
           WHERE u.Item_id = i.id
             AND u.is_deleted = 0
       ), '[]') AS uom_conversion_json
FROM JSON_TABLE(CONCAT('[', '{{node:code_node_kaS0Zdzg.data.item_id_csv}}', ']'),
                '$[*]' COLUMNS (mid BIGINT PATH '$')) sel
JOIN item i
  ON i.id = sel.mid
 AND i.is_deleted = 0

SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN '{{node:code_node_CyHkGZto.data.source}}' = 'SO' THEN 'SO'
    WHEN '{{node:code_node_CyHkGZto.data.source}}' = 'SQT' THEN 'SQT'
    WHEN '{{node:code_node_CyHkGZto.data.source}}' = 'PREQ' THEN 'PREQ'
    WHEN '{{node:code_node_CyHkGZto.data.source}}' = 'PO' THEN 'PO'
    WHEN '{{node:code_node_CyHkGZto.data.source}}' = 'SI' THEN 'SI'
    WHEN '{{node:code_node_CyHkGZto.data.source}}' = 'PI' THEN 'PI'
  END AS document_type,
  id,
  material_id,
  quantity,
  party_id,
  plant_id,
  unit_price,
  organization_id,
  create_time
FROM (
  -- SO
  SELECT 
    sos.id,
    sos.item_name AS material_id,
    sos.so_quantity AS quantity,
    sos.customer_id AS party_id,
    sos.plant_id,
    sos.so_item_price AS unit_price,
    sos.organization_id,
    sos.create_time,
    'SO' AS doc_type
  FROM sales_order_axszx8cj_sub sos
  WHERE sos.item_name IN ('{{node:loop_K5yRwowj.item_id}}')
    AND sos.plant_id = '{{node:code_node_kaS0Zdzg.data.plantIdSafe}}'
    AND sos.customer_id = '{{node:code_node_kaS0Zdzg.data.suppCustIdSafe}}'
    AND sos.so_item_uom = '{{node:loop_K5yRwowj.uom_id}}'
    AND sos.is_deleted = 0
    AND sos.line_status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Draft')
  
  UNION ALL
  
  -- SQT
  SELECT 
    sqt.id,
    sqt.material_id,
    sqt.quantity,
    sqt.customer_id AS party_id,
    sqt.plant_id,
    sqt.unit_price,
    sqt.organization_id,
    sqt.create_time,
    'SQT' AS doc_type
  FROM quotation_rdywe1rx_sub sqt
  JOIN quotation q ON sqt.quotation_id = q.id
  WHERE sqt.material_id IN ('{{node:loop_K5yRwowj.item_id}}')
    AND sqt.plant_id = '{{node:code_node_kaS0Zdzg.data.plantIdSafe}}'
    AND sqt.customer_id = '{{node:code_node_kaS0Zdzg.data.suppCustIdSafe}}'
    AND sqt.sqt_order_uom_id = '{{node:loop_K5yRwowj.uom_id}}'
    AND sqt.is_deleted = 0
    AND q.sqt_status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Draft')
  
  UNION ALL
  
  -- PREQ
  SELECT 
    preq.id,
    preq.pr_line_material_id AS material_id,
    preq.pr_line_qty AS quantity,
    preq.supplier_id AS party_id,
    preq.plant_id,
    preq.pr_line_unit_price AS unit_price,
    preq.organization_id,
    preq.create_time,
    'PREQ' AS doc_type
  FROM purchase_requisition_9wptilyh_sub preq
  WHERE preq.pr_line_material_id IN ('{{node:loop_K5yRwowj.item_id}}')
    AND preq.pr_line_uom_id = '{{node:loop_K5yRwowj.uom_id}}'
    AND preq.plant_id = '{{node:code_node_kaS0Zdzg.data.plantIdSafe}}'
    AND preq.supplier_id = '{{node:code_node_kaS0Zdzg.data.suppCustIdSafe}}'
    AND preq.is_deleted = 0
    AND preq.line_status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Draft')
  
  UNION ALL
  
  -- PO
  SELECT 
    po.id,
    po.item_id AS material_id,
    po.quantity,
    po.supplier_id AS party_id,
    po.plant_id,
    po.unit_price,
    po.organization_id,
    po.create_time,
    'PO' AS doc_type
  FROM purchase_order_2ukyuanr_sub po
  WHERE po.item_id IN ('{{node:loop_K5yRwowj.item_id}}')
    AND po.plant_id = '{{node:code_node_kaS0Zdzg.data.plantIdSafe}}'
    AND po.supplier_id = '{{node:code_node_kaS0Zdzg.data.suppCustIdSafe}}'
    AND po.quantity_uom = '{{node:loop_K5yRwowj.uom_id}}'
    AND po.is_deleted = 0
    AND po.line_status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Draft')
  
  UNION ALL
  
  -- SI (Sales Invoice)
  SELECT 
    si.id,
    si.material_id,
    si.invoice_qty AS quantity,
    si.customer_id AS party_id,
    si.plant_id,
    si.unit_price,
    si_header.organization_id,
    si.create_time,
    'SI' AS doc_type
  FROM sales_invoice_zt0c3x55_sub si
  JOIN sales_invoice si_header ON si.sales_invoice_id = si_header.id
  WHERE si.material_id IN ('{{node:loop_K5yRwowj.item_id}}')
    AND si.plant_id = '{{node:code_node_kaS0Zdzg.data.plantIdSafe}}'
    AND si.customer_id = '{{node:code_node_kaS0Zdzg.data.suppCustIdSafe}}'
    AND si.invoice_qty_uom_id = '{{node:loop_K5yRwowj.uom_id}}'
    AND si.is_deleted = 0
    AND si_header.si_status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Draft')

  UNION ALL

  -- PI (Purchase Invoice)
  SELECT 
    pi.id,
    pi.material_id,
    pi.invoice_qty AS quantity,
    pi.supplier_id AS party_id,
    pi.plant_id,
    pi.order_unit_price AS unit_price,
    pi_header.organization_id,
    pi.create_time,
    'PI' AS doc_type
  FROM purchase_invoice_xpuy7o4q_sub pi
  JOIN purchase_invoice pi_header ON pi.purchase_invoice_id = pi_header.id
  WHERE pi.material_id IN ('{{node:loop_K5yRwowj.item_id}}')
    AND pi.plant_id = '{{node:code_node_kaS0Zdzg.data.plantIdSafe}}'
    AND pi.supplier_id = '{{node:code_node_kaS0Zdzg.data.suppCustIdSafe}}'
    AND pi.quantity_uom = '{{node:loop_K5yRwowj.uom_id}}'
    AND pi.is_deleted = 0
    AND pi_header.pi_status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Draft')
) combined
WHERE doc_type = '{{node:code_node_CyHkGZto.data.source}}'
ORDER BY create_time DESC
LIMIT 1;

-- Supplier prices
SELECT 
  'Supplier' AS price_type,
  sq.id,
  sq.supplier_id AS party_id,
  sq.Item_id,
  sq.sup_price_uom AS uom_id,
  sq.sup_min_order_qty AS min_order_qty,
  sq.sup_max_order_qty AS max_order_qty,
  sq.sup_price_date_from AS price_date_from,
  sq.sup_price_date_to AS price_date_to,
  sq.sup_price_tag_id AS price_tag_id,
  sq.sup_price_discount AS discount,
  sq.sup_price_discount_type AS discount_type,
  sq.sup_price_tax AS tax,
  sq.sup_price_tax_percent AS tax_percent,  
  sq.sup_price_unit_price AS unit_price,
  sq.sup_price_min_price AS min_price,
  sq.sup_price_max_price AS max_price
FROM item_qd8nxw32_sub sq
JOIN item i ON sq.Item_id = i.id
WHERE sq.is_deleted = 0
  AND (
    sq.sup_price_tag_id = '{{node:code_node_aw4JItTz.data.price_tag_id}}'
    OR (
      '{{node:code_node_kaS0Zdzg.data.suppCustIdSafe}}' IS NOT NULL 
      AND '{{node:code_node_kaS0Zdzg.data.suppCustIdSafe}}' != ''
      AND sq.supplier_id = '{{node:code_node_kaS0Zdzg.data.suppCustIdSafe}}'
    )
  )
  AND (
    (sq.sup_price_date_from IS NULL AND sq.sup_price_date_to IS NULL)
    OR (sq.sup_price_date_from < CURDATE() AND sq.sup_price_date_to IS NULL)
    OR (sq.sup_price_date_from IS NULL AND sq.sup_price_date_to > CURDATE())
    OR (sq.sup_price_date_from < CURDATE() AND sq.sup_price_date_to > CURDATE())
  )
  AND sq.Item_id = {{node:loop_K5yRwowj.item_id}}
  AND sq.sup_price_uom = {{node:loop_K5yRwowj.uom_id}}
  AND (
    ((sq.sup_min_order_qty <= {{node:loop_K5yRwowj.quantity}} OR sq.sup_min_order_qty = 0)
     AND (sq.sup_max_order_qty >= {{node:loop_K5yRwowj.quantity}} OR sq.sup_max_order_qty = 0))
  )
  AND '{{node:code_node_T4JW4d6p.data.fetch_data_from}}' = 'Supplier'

UNION ALL
